bash_commands: git ls-files; head -c 64 garmin-export.csv | xxd; grep -rn "expected the header" --include=* . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^./.git/' | head
cat src/trailhead/track.py; cat tests/test_track.py; grep -rn "open(\|read_text\|encoding" src | grep -v "track.py"

python - <<'EOF'

    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):''','''    header_seen = False
    # Some exporters (Garmin, Excel) start UTF-8 files with a byte order mark.

p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_track.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''def test_bad_header():''','''def test_byte_order_mark_is_ignored(write_track):

    assert parse_track("\\ufeff# name: Musala\\nlat,lon,ele\\n0,0,0\\n0,0.01,0\\n").name == "Musala"


def test_bad_header():''')
